text: Binary per-row check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed). Returns 1 if every comment argues solely through abstract logical refutation (general reasoning, principles, definitions, logical structure) and none references a specific, named external program or location. Returns 0 if any comment names a specific external program or location, or relies on any non-abstract content such as concrete examples, anecdotes, or data. Ignores text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not ignored). Returns null if the list is empty, missing, or malformed; list order is irrelevant.
